description:
Perform an internal link equity audit for 'https://books.toscrape.com/'. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider and crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'. Wait for the crawl to finish.
2. Use the 'Bulk Export' menu (Bulk Export > Links > All Inlinks) to export the internal link data. Save the CSV file to '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/'.
3. Analyze the data and write a text report saved to '/home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/internal_links_report.txt'.

The report must include:
- Total number of internal links found.
- The top 5 most-linked pages.
- Examples of under-linked pages (pages with few inlinks).
- An analysis of the most common anchor text used.
- At least 3 specific recommendations for improving the internal linking structure.
